title: Patrick Mahomes to get more tests on right elbow after Sunday's injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Patrick Mahomes to get more tests on right elbow after Sunday's injury
sources.description: Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes didn't miss any offensive snaps until garbage time in Sunday's 35-12 win over the Jets, but it looked like he might have suffered a serious injury late in the first half.
